profile.headline: Website Manager, Web Developer, Digital Content Producer
profile.summary: Creative content master and technical translator skilled in website design and development, content management, video production, database management, and image editing. Expert in WordPress and experience working in WebOps SAAS. Organized, efficient, technical, and entertaining.

positions.title: Web Developer & Digital Content Producer
positions.description: Managed complete redesign of website. Routinely update and improve site via new plugins, language updates, and new functionality. Identify user experience issues and create product roadmaps to improve customer experience. Work with developers, content producers, and other stakeholders to create product development plan and oversee it to completion. Troubleshoot technical issues in WordPress code base, and work with external partners on updates and malfunctions. Create informational videos to accompany website posts and manage YouTube channel (including creating videos with 100k views). Respond to customer inquiries about website and subscriptions, and fix issues with Javascript-based tools. Work with multiple departments and websites across company, providing updates and advice for every division.
positions.insights: Skills: WordPress · Product Management · Website Development · Digital Marketing · Web Production Management

company.name: Sky and Telescope/ American Astronomical Society

positions.title: Web Product Deployment Manager
positions.description: Worked with customers and internal teams to build and update WordPress websites, including content migration, page layouts, CSS styling, plugin setup, API integration, and templating. Manadde website products, new features, and bug fixes. Assisted product manager in developing new features based on customer feedback and overall industry trends. Served as sole customer support agent for over 100 customers. Create, edit, and manage product documentation.
positions.insights: Skills: Website Development · Product Management · WordPress · Web Production Management · Web Design

positions.title: Website Developer, Writer/Editor
positions.description:
Edit and proofread web content, resumes, application essays, white papers, law books, phone call transcriptions, help files, workbooks, and non-fiction and fiction pieces.  Write web content, online articles, articles for print, and marketing materials including SEO-rich coupons and blurbs.  Manage web content for diverse audiences and ensure proper market targeting.  Edit many different kinds of documents including those written by non-native English speakers. 

Website development and design using WordPress and other CMS for small businesses and individuals. Focus on user-friendly responsive design. SEO, social media consulting and integration, project management, content creation and editing, website management, video editing, and more.

volunteerExperiences.description: Supported a team of 4-6 high-school entrepreneurs during two academic years. Assisted and guided with developing a product and business plan, and executing related tasks.

International volunteer in Tanzania, Russia, and Peru for 1-12 weeks each. Various work assignments including working at orphanages and centers for at-risk youth, supporting AIDS patients, assisting elderly persons, and working with the deaf.
